name: ChemiCloud
summary: Lightning-fast cloud hosting with free migrations, daily backups, and 24/7 expert support. Perfect balance of performance and affordability for growing businesses.
best_for: small businesses, freelancers and growing sites that want fast, well-supported managed shared or WordPress hosting at a low starting price
skip_if: you need enterprise-grade dedicated infrastructure and SLAs, or you'll be unhappy when the low intro rate renews at standard pricing
honest_knock: The honest catch is the one every budget host shares: the headline price is an introductory rate, and renewals land roughly three times higher, so judge it on the renewal cost, not the sign-up teaser. Support and performance reviews are genuinely strong for the price band, but this is shared/managed hosting — if you need serious dedicated resources or enterprise SLAs, you'll outgrow the cheap tiers. Great value to start, just enter with eyes open on renewal.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month on the 36-month term (Black Friday sale, until 7 December 2026)
pricing.notes: (re-verified 2026-11-02) Shared hosting starts at $1.49/mo on ChemiCloud's Black Friday sale, which went live on 2 November 2026 and replaced the Back to Build sale: Starter, Pro and Turbo cost $1.49, $2.49 and $3.49 a month on the 36-month term, or $2.95, $3.95 and $4.95 on 12 months. The site advertises it as up to 88% off on 36-month plans; ChemiCloud told its affiliates it runs until 7 December 2026, and the pages we read carry no end date. The number that matters is the regular rate, because the terms say a plan renews at the regular rate after the first term, and that rate depends on the term you buy: the 36-month cards show $11.95, $17.95 and $21.95 a month, the 12-month cards $14.95, $19.95 and $23.95, which is also what the three tiers cost on monthly billing. Across the rest of the range, reseller starts at $17.95/mo (Kickstart, regular $34.95), managed cloud VPS at $32.95/mo (Cloud 1, regular $59.95, on a 7-day money-back guarantee rather than 45 days), and managed WordPress at $25/mo with a $1 first month, or $12.50/mo on the Black Friday annual offer: $150 for the first year, which the card calls six months free, renewing at the regular annual rate. Shared plans include a free domain, free SSL, daily backups and free migration.
